split_policy: PR-disjoint prospective confirmation; both variants remain in their family split.
exposure: Both PRs appeared in v1 evaluations and were inspected during v2 dataset construction. Confirmation is not a previously unseen holdout.
limitations: Labels cover three audited root causes, not every defect in each PR.
Repaired cases test absence of named roots; they are not certified globally clean.
Agent inspection and deterministic reproductions do not establish human grader calibration.

roots.title: Optional null repository produces broken inventory links
roots.trigger: The finalize CLI omits --refused-inventory-repo and forwards null with a known nonempty inventory.
roots.mechanism: The parameter default only applies to undefined; null is interpolated into the GitHub link.
roots.consequence: Tracker inventory links point to github.com/null/issues/<number>.

roots.title: Trailing newline rejects a valid cloud claim
roots.trigger: A trusted claim includes a handoff footer and ends with a newline.
roots.mechanism: The split leaves an empty trailing line; isBoundedCloudHandoff rejects every empty line.
roots.consequence: Backfill rejects the valid claim as absent.

roots.title: Missing optional branch rejects claim metadata
roots.trigger: A trusted claim originates in detached HEAD and omits its optional Branch field.
roots.mechanism: parseClaimComment requires branch to be a nonempty string although the claim writer omits unavailable branches.
roots.consequence: Backfill cannot recover Agent, Claim ID, or Claimed At fields.
